title: Girolamo Augustoni (as catalogued), 9 Oct 1612, a letter in clear with words in cipher (Biblioteca Estense, Campori A, Augustoni c. 1; catalogue 1569): read in part

documents.shelfmark: Biblioteca Estense Universitaria, Modena, Autografoteca Campori, Lettera A, Augustoni, Girolamo, c. 1
documents.route: Girolamo Augustoni (the library's attribution; signature not read by us) to a correspondent not named on the page

plaintext.source: No decipherment on c. 1r or c. 1v (seen on the images).

transcription.source: Estense Digital Library IIIF images (edl-jarvis.cultura.gov.it), record 516e565f-7451-43fe-a2fc-533c0b5efeee
transcription.notes: Counted by scripts/build.py (units.tsv), not by docs/_check_profile.py --measure, so measured is false. 600 units in 30 lines: 580 cipher signs, 3 signs not legible, 4 clear-script letters inside cipher words, 6 of an abbreviation sign, 7 codes. distinct counts the labels of the consensus transcription: 26 sign labels, the abbreviation sign, the mark for a sign not legible, 1 clear-script letter that is not also a sign label (s) and 3 codes. Cipher words: a consensus of the first reader's second transcription (not blind) and a blind second transcription by another session (transcription_blind.txt), frozen and stamped 11 Nov 2026. Clear text: one reader, 12 Nov 2026, after the key was known. The page begins in mid-sentence.

system.summary: Simple substitution with letter-like signs, 25 signs for 19 letters, a few letters having two or three signs; u and v are one letter and there is no sign for q or z. Only single words and phrases are in cipher, inside a letter in clear, with word division kept. Persons are also hidden by codes written in clear script with points (I., PP., 25., .50.), which the key does not touch. One abbreviation compound is written as a single sign.
system.doubled_letters: written twice (rissolse, quassi, tottal, habbno); single in rochetta, acordo, letera, scritura
system.notes: distinct_symbols counts the sign labels of the consensus transcription: 24 of the 25 key signs occur (the b-form does not; two carry the blind reader's names, R for K and D for z), plus the rounded u-form (label υ, read as the n sign: a split made after decoding, 8 units) and the Z form (once, no key value) = 26. The four codes are counted under nomenclator as names; none is identified, and .50. stands in the clear text, not among the cipher units.

prior_solution.where: None found; priority not established. Checked on 11 Nov 2026: this repository (catalogue row 1569 open, no target folder), the catalogue vetting, web searches, the Archivio di Stato di Modena inventory of the Cancelleria ducale, Ambasciatori, Milano (no Augustoni 1600-1620). Not checked: Biblioteca comunale di Correggio (notes on the Augustoni family); Archivio di Stato di Milano, Carteggio delle cancellerie dello Stato; the printed Campori catalogue; the Este agents' series page by page.

solution.what: First transcription of the cipher words of c. 1r from the IIIF images (pass 1), frozen. It merged two pairs of signs (the a sign with one u sign, the t sign with the other).

Own annealer with Italian quadgrams on pass 1, four restarts of 20,000 steps, no crib and no gloss: two restarts gave Italian words (rimetendolo, volessero, dubitiamo, li feudi, compromesso, negotiato, la causa).
Second transcription by the same reader at full width (pass 2), not blind: made after the solver output, which showed the two merged pairs. Key frozen from it: 25 signs, 19 letters.
Pass 2 under the key against 5,000 shuffled keys: 301 of 607 signs in Italian dictionary words against a best of 40; none of the 5,000 as good. First strict count on pass 2: 462 of 607 units (76.1%).

Blind second transcription by another session that opened only the page images, frozen before it opened the key or any decode. Under the key: 394 of 587 signs in dictionary words against a best of 60 for 5,000 shuffled keys. It showed that one of its labels covered two forms (plain u and a rounded form).

Consensus of pass 2 and the blind transcription on crops; single decoder with a file of label aliases and 13 coordinate overrides; ledger of one row per unit. Issue 427 gave 548 of 583 cipher units (94.0%).
Two words tried and not adopted: l'[i]ngano on L16 and scr[i]tura on L17-18. A third left open between argutia and astutia (L19).

Check by Daniel Bourdeau on issue 427: his decoder reproduces the literal lines; 0 of 5,000 shuffled keys; about 200 signs agree with the image. His recount is 537 of 587 (91.5%): our total left out 4 clear-script letters and our count kept 10 units of two emended words as read. He offered INGANO, ASTUTIA, SCR[I]TURA, CONSCENSO and 'sia'.

For this folder: the five readings checked on the image and adopted (one sign added, two relabelled, one emended, one value changed; not blind); the clear text read in full for the first time, which also showed that 'S.S.' in the issue is a code, .50.; every emendation listed. One cipher unit is left unread.

Web searches for an edition or decipherment; the repository; the Modena inventory of the Milan ambassadors' series. Nothing found. Correggio, the Milan state archive and the printed Campori catalogue were not searched.

outcome.method_basis: An annealer with Italian quadgrams on the first transcription of the cipher words gave Italian without any crib; the leaf carries no decipherment. The key was completed by reading. The clear text around the cipher words was used afterwards, for the 13 overrides and to settle doubtful words, not to find the key.
outcome.fraction_read_source: units.tsv and counts.txt (scripts/build.py), on the transcription frozen 11 Nov 2026. The reviewer's count: 537 of 587 cipher units give the letter read by the key and the label aliases (91.5%), 35 emended, 15 unread; ours by his rule, 538. With the 8 units of a sign split made after decoding also counted emended, 530 (90.3%). The blind transcription by the same rule, 517 (88.1%). After the image review of 12 Nov (not blind), 1 unit of 588 is unread.

texts.label: Augustoni, 9 Oct 1612, c. 1r
texts.summary: Part of a report to a correspondent addressed as 'Sig.r mio', on a negotiation over fiefs; Rochetta is named. A person hidden as 50 said nothing and referred the matter to the Provost, and it was settled through a person hidden as I. The writer doubts this: the other side wanted something else and lost their nerve. The ministers pressed harder than I. for the fiefs not to be excluded from the 'compromesso', and the Grand Chancellor and the Provost were agreed. By cunning the writer's side has got a letter of the Provost saying that a certain addition can only mean the total exclusion of the fiefs. I. was very low and tried in vain to visit PP. The reader is to keep informed, not show his hand without need, and take care in writing to the Provost. Postscript: the Governor of Milan has offered to write to the King and has written to the Spanish ambassador.

reading_review.by: Claude (Anthropic), for Malcolm McBratney: a model reading, not a person, and not independent (the session that prepared these files). Offered so the entry is complete; the reviewer's own record should replace it before merging.
reading_review.note: Read as sentences against the translation. The body runs as connected Italian and its argument can be followed. Holes: four unidentified codes for persons in most sentences, an abbreviation sign read 'per' from context or not at all, one unread cipher sign, eleven words with a supplied or emended letter, and about a dozen doubtful clear words. The end of the postscript is read only in part and is set apart.

texts.note: read_share 0.849 is our count of the README word rule on reading.md (314 words, 56 holes): codes, doubtful words and every word with a supplied or emended letter count as holes, and the clear text is counted with the cipher. By cipher units the reviewer's figure is 91.5%. transcription_blind.txt is the blind second transcription in its own sign names.

outcome.notes: Filed as read in part. The 94.0% of issue 427 is withdrawn: it left 4 clear-script letters out of the total and kept 10 units of two emended words as read. The reviewer's 537 of 587 (91.5%) is the stated figure. The decode rests on 25 key values, on two renamed labels, on one split of a blind label made after decoding (8 units) and on 13 overrides by coordinate, all in the key files; NOTES.md says which is which. The shuffled-key controls are from our own scripts; docs/_validate.py was not run and no validation block is claimed. The reviewer's check on issue 427 (his decoder, his shuffled-key control, his comparison with the image) is his to record; it is not claimed in verification here. The repository's checker scripts were not run by the contributor; the checks were verified by reading them (pull request text). The contributor id mcbratney is added to contributors.json by pull request 445 (muzio1550), not by this one.
